claim: Follow links to your social profiles, or share links for the page a visitor is on, can sit wherever an editor places them
Visitors see small icons, text labels or both, drawn as plain links that load no scripts from the networks
You keep one list for each site, on the Socials page under the Growth menu in the admin
Choose a network, type a handle or address, and add a public label if you want one
Eleven networks are built in, including X, Facebook and LinkedIn, and a custom link covers anything else
Handles and addresses are checked against the network, and a preview shows the follow and share links before you save
A developer runs the install command once; it sets up the storage for your lists and also runs every other pending database update
Editors add the Socials block and pick Follow or Share, a heading and how it is aligned
People limited to certain sites can edit only those sites' lists
Clicking a share link opens the visitor's network with the page's address filled in, plus its title on networks that take one
